cv_page.intro: The same experience, skills and documents as this site, in one file for applications and printing.
cv_page.profile_text: Senior Software Engineer with 6+ years of commercial experience architecting, scaling, and delivering 100+ high-performance web applications and data-intensive platforms across GIS/digital-twin, fintech, and e-commerce, serving 1M+ users. Proven track record of technical leadership, leading and mentoring teams of up to 18 engineers, and full SDLC ownership.
cv_page.profile_text_2: Deep expertise in React, Next.js, and TypeScript, backed by production backend development with Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB. Integrated AI-assisted development workflows with Cursor, Claude Code, and GitHub Copilot, automating quality gates and repetitive engineering tasks to cut time-to-market by ~2x.
cv_page.achievement_1: Designed a multi-layer caching and invalidation strategy across 10+ platforms, cutting redundant API traffic by 50% and reducing cloud infrastructure costs by an estimated 20%. (Ciklum)
cv_page.achievement_2: Created shared frontend engineering standards for code reviews and component architecture, adopted across 2 companies and 100+ production projects, shortening onboarding for new engineers by 40%.
